scope: Actual native images inspected by story author; FL01 and FL05 covered in earlier reports.

items.observation: Ada presents coat onto Corin forearm/notebook rather than dropping immediately; next panel grounds it. Both gloves still worn. Acting establishes skeptical investigator and worried sibling.
One footprint beside ledge and coat grounded; both gloves. Finger points at evidence.
Actual bare LEFT hand poised above stone-bounded ground pool, glove removed nearby and pole grounded. Ada visible, no early eel or memory.
Ripples erase memory and Corin restrains Ada. Bare/gloved anatomical sides reverse. Pool changes shape but stays ground water.
Eel rises below dry ledge, Corin between threat and Ada, no visible Lio yet. Pole uses straight butt toward creature.
Eel mouth below edge and Corin retreats/holds height advantage. Dry-ledge limitation reads, though mouth appears near boot.
Lio in mouth with key and boot brushing ledge gives actual footprint explanation. Clear danger and two adults above.
Corin braces pole at upper lip only, not a two-jaw prop; victim inside. Lower contact missing.
Two vertically stacked C sections replace single head; upper contact outside rim and lower section at ledge. Causal jaw-prop construction fails despite braced stance. Prioritize structural repair.
Ada actively hauls Lio shoulders while he crawls onto dry ledge; spatial rescue reads. Pole again shows upper contact only, unresolved even if FL11 repaired.
All three safely on ledge, eel visibly retreats, coat stays ground. Immediate danger resolved.
Lio speaks exhausted, triangular key still necklace; no premature transfer.
One matching triangular key transferred from Lio partial arm to Corin bare LEFT palm; investigative gate behind.
Two siblings leave together while detective faces huge sluice with retained triangular key. Key shifts to RIGHT, but story direction and sole ownership clear.
